subject: Pushed ability to save warmup samples

messages.author: 2a7f346506a3e9ff
messages.subject: Pushed ability to save warmup samples
parts:
A command line parameter --save_warmup will now dump the warmup samples to the CSV file.  This is, of course, off by default but is now there for people that want it.

Cheers,
Marcus

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] Pushed ability to save warmup samples
parts:
That's great.

I just updated the LaTeX manual to
match the doc Marcus put in the command.

I've also been meaning to get around to adding
a command to take one or more saved output files
and load them into an mcmc::chains() object so that
it'll be easy to print the same kind of output as
the R interface. I think Daniel already built the I/O
that we'll need.

- Bob
